china_footprint.ssc_location: No dedicated finance SSC identified in China. Medtronic's global business services / shared services for finance are centered in India (Hyderabad) and other global hubs, not China.
china_footprint.notes: Medtronic has operated in China for 30+ years ('35 years' per 2024 Xinhua coverage). Footprint: ~12 regional offices, ~6,000 employees, 1 R&D center, 2 innovation centers (Shanghai + Chengdu - China is the only single market globally with two), and 3 major manufacturing bases (Shanghai, Chengdu, Changzhou). The Shanghai management entity (WFOE, est. 2000-06-08, registered capital USD 2M, USCC 9131000060741770XH, in Shanghai FTZ / Donghua Financial Tower) handles investment, marketing, capital operations & financial management, tech support/R&D, info services and training for Medtronic group entities in China - i.e. it performs an internal management/services role but is not a named multi-country finance SSC.

erp: SAP (mySAP Business Suite selected 2003 to consolidate global legacy ERPs onto a single SAP platform; SAP HANA strategic BI platform - one of earliest global adopters, scaled multi-node; hundreds of interconnected SAP systems on-prem and cloud)
expense_travel: SAP Concur Expense (strong indication - see concur_details)
tech_stack.concur_details: Strong evidence Medtronic uses SAP Concur for T&E. (1) A dedicated employee expense portal exists at myexpenses.medtronic.com ('Medtronic | Expense Reimbursement'). (2) AppsRunTheWorld lists 'Medtronic Switzerland selects SAP Concur Expense for expense management', indicating Concur adoption within the Medtronic group. (3) Medtronic is a heavy SAP shop globally (SAP ERP + SAP HANA), and Concur integrates natively with SAP. Not 100% confirmed that the China entities run the same Concur instance, but group-level Concur usage is highly likely. Confidence: medium-high. China-specific Concur deployment: unconfirmed - a key qualification target.

business_events.title: Medtronic Kanghui Changzhou Technology Park comprehensive upgrade
business_events.summary: Strategic upgrade with Changzhou High-Tech Zone to build 4 functional centers (Smart Manufacturing, Research Excellence, Innovation Incubation, Customer Innovation Experience). Positions Changzhou as a regional base for Medtronic's global supply chain and Kanghui's global HQ. New building expected complete summer 2025, official operations 2026. Originally announced June 2022.

business_events.title: Medtronic Lingang (Shanghai) cardiovascular manufacturing base completed / operational
business_events.summary: ~RMB 300M first-phase investment in Shanghai Lingang New Area; first Fortune 500 medical company in Lingang (signed Oct 2021). Cardiovascular device R&D and localized manufacturing; targeted 5 new products to mass production and 500th employee by 2024.

business_events.title: Medtronic appoints MiniMed CFO ahead of planned diabetes business separation
business_events.summary: Medtronic is separating its MiniMed (diabetes) business into a standalone company and named a dedicated CFO - signals significant finance/systems carve-out activity group-wide.

business_events.title: Thierry Piéton becomes Global EVP & CFO
business_events.summary: New global CFO appointment - finance leadership transition often a window for finance-transformation / systems review.

business_events.title: Medtronic named 'Top Employer China 2025' (中国杰出雇主2025)
business_events.summary: Signals continued investment in China workforce and HR/people systems.

ai_summary_cn: 美敦力（Medtronic, NYSE:MDT）是全球最大的医疗科技企业，FY2025全球营收约335亿美元、员工9.5万+。在华深耕30余年，约6,000名员工、约12个办事处，中国总部在上海；拥有1个研发中心（上海2012）、2个创新中心（上海2005、成都2021，中国是全球唯一拥有两个创新中心的市场）及3大生产基地（上海临港心血管工厂2023投产、成都、常州康辉骨科科技园）。主体公司为美敦力（上海）管理有限公司（WFOE，2000年成立，法定代表人邓坚，承担集团在华投资、营销、资金运作与财务管理、研发及培训等内部管理/共享职能）。ERP方面美敦力是深度SAP用户（2003年起mySAP统一全球ERP，SAP HANA为全球BI平台，全球数百套SAP系统），费控/差旅极可能已用SAP Concur（集团瑞士实体已选用Concur Expense，且存在员工报销门户myexpenses.medtronic.com），但中国本地是否同一Concur实例尚未证实——这是关键的销售切入与确认点。无专门的中国财务共享中心，集团财务共享更多在印度等地。近期信号丰富：2025年3月新任全球CFO、2025年7月为MiniMed糖尿病业务拆分任命独立CFO（涉及财务/系统剥离）、常州康辉科技园2025完工2026运营、临港工厂持续扩产、获评中国杰出雇主2025，并出现SAP角色管理等招聘。综合判断：在华规模大、SAP底座成熟、Concur大概率已用但中国落地待确认、本土化与拆分带来财务数字化机会窗口。建议以'确认中国是否已上Concur及财务共享/费控本地化'为切入点。
